provider.description: The location provider to use (e.g. geoclue2, manual, internal).

transition.description: Transition duration from day to night and night to day, formatted as 'day_to_night:night_to_day' in minutes.

day_temp.description: Color temperature in Kelvin to set during daytime.

night_temp.description: Color temperature in Kelvin to set during nighttime.

location_lat.description: Latitude coordinate for manual location provider.

location_lon.description: Longitude coordinate for manual location provider.
